# Assumption of Moses Chapter 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Moses Comforts Joshua

---

**1** And Moses heard him and comforted him and said to him:

**2** Joshua, do not despair for your people, and do not grieve on their account.

**3** God has foreseen all things and has made provision for the fulfillment of his covenant from before the beginning of time.

**4** He created the world for their sake but did not make his intention known from the beginning, so that the nations might be judged and humiliated, and that his purpose might be revealed.

**5** He will indeed punish them, but he will comfort them again when the time of his mercy arrives.

**6** For I am going the way of all the earth, but God remains faithful to his covenant.

**7** Know, Joshua, that the God who created the world on behalf of his people will act as mediator for them and will look upon them with his compassion.

**8** For he has not forgotten them nor will he ever forget them.

**9** But he will come to them again in his own time and will show them his mercy.

**10** He has appointed me to pray on behalf of their sins and to intercede for them.

**11** For I am the mediator of his covenant and the prophet appointed to intercede for Israel.

**12** Go therefore, Joshua, in strength of soul, and serve the Lord God faithfully.

**13** For he chose me and appointed me as the mediator of his covenant.

**14** God created the earth for the sake of his people and will judge the whole world, bringing punishment upon the wicked and comfort to the righteous.

**15** I, Moses, have been appointed to pray for the people and to intercede on their behalf and to give them the law.

**16** Therefore be comforted, Joshua, and serve the Lord and do his will.

**17** God will lead his people and will not forsake them, for he is a God of truth and faithfulness.

**18** His covenant will stand forever, and his promise will be fulfilled at the appointed time.
